title: Screen Time Overage by App Category
dataSources: Nanit sleep sessions (`nanit:sleep`), Hatch routines (`hatch:routine`), school calendar events (`schoolcalendar:event`), allowance transactions (`allowance:txn`), and kid screen usage (`screentime:usage`).
app: Family-routine telemetry from Nanit sleep exports, Hatch routine data, school calendars, allowance and chore apps, and Apple Screen Time sent to Splunk HEC via APIs and scripted inputs.
spl:
index=personal sourcetype=screentime:usage
| search over_limit_min>0
| bin _time span=1d
| stats sum(over_limit_min) as over_limit_min by _time app_category
| sort - _time
description: Tracks screen-time overages over time and breaks it out by app category.
value: Category-level overages show whether the problem is games, video, or everything equally.
implementation: Send screen-time overages events to `index=personal` with the fields used in the breakdown and review the resulting trend at 1d granularity.
visualization: Stacked time chart of screen-time overages by app category.
grandmaExplanation: It reveals how screen-time overages changes over time so the busy spells and quiet spells stand out.
